title: ai-atoms skill v1
description: A skill atom — a bounded, invocable unit of AI capability with a declared system-prompt fragment, inputs, outputs, and side effects.

id.description: Namespaced identifier in the form skill/<slug>.

version.description: Semantic version of this skill atom.

description.description: What this skill does, when to invoke it, and what it prevents.

system_prompt_fragment.description: The prompt fragment injected into an AI agent's system context when this skill is loaded. Must be self-contained and actionable.

applicable_domains.description: Domains where this skill applies (e.g. code, design, planning, debug, agents).

category.description: Single primary category used to group skills for selection/presentation. Display names: coding=Engineering & Coding, dotnet=.NET / Microsoft Engineering, data=Data, Analytics & Research, design=Design & UX, product=Product & Delivery, operations=Operations & IT, finance=Finance & Accounting, legal=Legal & Compliance, sales=Sales & CRM, marketing=Marketing & Content, hr=People & HR, support=Customer Support, knowledge=Knowledge & Docs, governance=Governance & Meta.

depends_on.description: Sub-skills this skill installs on `ai skills install` and hides from the top-level catalog list (dispatcher pattern). Each entry is a namespaced skill id, e.g. "skill/make-work".

invocation_contract.description: Declared inputs, outputs, and side effects for this skill.

invocation.description: Slash-command invocation forms, e.g. ["/debug", "/debug \"<symptom>\"", "/debug --error <log>"]. Omit for skills with no slash-command entry point.

authored_by.description: Key atom ID or author identifier (e.g. 'convergent-systems-key', 'anthropics', 'kepano').

provenance.description: Where this atom came from and who deserves credit. Present on every atom imported from an external source; omit only for original first-party work.

source.description: Stable identifier of the upstream source the atom was taken from, e.g. "anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins", "obsidian-kepano", "claudeskills.in".

source_type.description: What kind of source this came from. first-party = authored in this catalog.

source_url.description: URL of the original artifact upstream, used for attribution and for tracking upstream changes.

author.description: Original author or maintainer to credit, as they identify themselves upstream (org, handle, or person).

license.description: SPDX identifier of the upstream license (e.g. "Apache-2.0", "MIT", "CC-BY-4.0"), or "unknown" when the source states none. "unknown" means redistribution has not been cleared.

retrieved_at.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the atom was pulled from the source.

modified.description: Whether this atom's content was changed from the upstream original during import.

notes.description: Free-text attribution or licensing caveats a redistributor needs to know.

source_url.description: URL of the original source file when this atom was imported from an external open-source repository. Used for attribution and tracking upstream changes.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle stage of this skill atom.
